description.value: A year-round public aquatic centre in Grand Forks, originally opened in 1987 and operated by the Regional District of Kootenay Boundary. The facility features four 25-metre lanes, a large shallow-water leisure area, sauna, whirlpool, and a fitness and wellness centre. For touring cyclists passing through the Boundary region, it offers a welcome chance to swim, soak in the hot tub, and clean up.
